biggest_catch: You need a referral link from a current tastytrade customer — there is no public signup path — plus a $1,000+ deposit within 60 days that must stay in the account for 6 months, and the $100 bonus itself cannot be withdrawn as cash until that 6-month period ends. Program ends November 30, 2026.
catches: The $100 requires a current customer's unique referral link — there is no public signup path on tastytrade.com/welcome for the referral bonus.
You must fund at least $1,000 within 60 days of opening; if the deposit falls below $1,000 during the 6-month period, the bonus can be revoked.
The $100 bonus is usable for trading immediately but cannot be withdrawn as cash until the 6-month holding period ends; trading losses do not disqualify you.
IRAs are excluded — only Individual, Entity, Joint, and Trust accounts qualify; you must be 18+ and a new U.S. customer who never had a tastytrade account.
Bonus deposited within 45 days of account opening/funding, not instantly.
tastytrade can modify, suspend, or cancel the program at any time without notice, and can reverse a referral credit 'for any reason at any time.'
Referrers are capped at 24 referral bonuses per year.

c4.evidence: Official terms: 'Referral bonuses will be deposited into both the Referrer's and Referral's respective accounts within forty-five (45) days of the Referral's account being opened and funded.' Program runs June 1, 2026 – November 30, 2026 (rules last revised August 14, 2026).

eligibility: New U.S. customers, 18+, who have never had a tastytrade account, opening an eligible Individual, Entity, Joint, or Trust account (NOT an IRA) through a referrer's unique referral link and funding it with $1,000 or more within 60 days of opening. Funds must remain in the account for six months.

steps: Get a unique referral link/code from a current tastytrade customer — there is no public signup path for the referral bonus.
Open a new eligible tastytrade account (Individual, Entity, Joint, or Trust — not an IRA) through that referral link; you must be 18+ and a new U.S. customer.
Fund the account with at least $1,000 within 60 days of opening.
Keep at least $1,000 in the account for 6 months — trading and market losses are fine, but withdrawing the deposit below $1,000 can revoke the bonus.
The $100 referral bonus is deposited into the account within 45 days of opening/funding; it is tradable immediately but cannot be withdrawn as cash until the 6-month period ends.
timing: Bonus deposited within 45 days of the account being opened and funded; the bonus may be withdrawn as cash only after the 6-month holding period ends.
